notes.detail: Flower boxes under every hall side window, bushes and flowers round the base, two benches each side, a lantern post by the porch, a red carpet runner from the tower porch into the hall entrance and red carpet in the council chamber, vines on the back corner.
notes.depth: Flower boxes add depth on both long sides; the back face is still flat.
notes.materials: Flower boxes are bare coarse-dirt cubes; they look crude but don't clash.
notes.life: Plenty: flowers, bushes, vines, flower boxes, lanterns.
notes.levels: Clearly different from L2: planted window boxes and greenery all round.

visual.summary: L3 adds the finishing touches: flower boxes on the hall windows, bushes and flowers round the base, benches, a lantern post, vines, red carpets and (decoration step) the clocks.
problems: Flower boxes are plain coarse-dirt cubes on a stair (x1/x11 y6 z6,8,10,12): give them a front (trapdoors on the outer face) so they read as planters, not dirt blocks.
Back face (z16-17) still flat; one detail there (gable window, sill, jetty) would finish it.
Reachability: same as L1/L2 (all rooms soldiers need are reached; tower clock chamber unreached; flower-box tops unreached: fine).
